# Line

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Renders a straight line with configurable color, width, and dash pattern.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `ElementBase`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new Line(options?: LineOptions)
```

## Properties

- [`color`](#color): Stroke colour.
- [`dashPattern`](#dashpattern): Alternating dash and gap lengths in points.
- [`length`](#length): Length of the line.
- [`orientation`](#orientation): Orientation of the line.
- [`thickness`](#thickness): thickness.

### `color`

```typescript
color: Color
```

Stroke colour. Accepts a palette token or hex.

Example, from `industry-templates/retail-events/edge-receipt`:

```typescript
line.color = MUTE;
```

Example, from `industry-templates/people-hr/employment-contract`:

```typescript
rule.color = FAINT;
```

### `dashPattern`

```typescript
dashPattern?: readonly number[] | undefined
```

*optional*

Alternating dash and gap lengths in points.

Example, from `industry-templates/billing-payments/utility-bill`:

```typescript
line.dashPattern = [3, 3];
```

Example, from `industry-templates/retail-events/edge-receipt`:

```typescript
line.dashPattern = [3, 4];
```

### `length`

```typescript
length: number | undefined
```

Length of the line. For Horizontal lines, if null (default), it takes the full available width. For Vertical lines, this determines the height. If null, defaults to 100.

Accepts a length: a number of points, `'5cm'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

### `orientation`

```typescript
orientation: LineOrientation
```

Orientation of the line. Default is Horizontal.

### `thickness`

```typescript
thickness: number
```

thickness. Accepts a length: a number of points, `'0.5pt'`, or `{ value, unit }`.

Example, from `industry-templates/retail-events/edge-receipt`:

```typescript
line.thickness = 0.8;
```

Example, from `code-recipes/barcodes-qr-codes/barcodes`:

```typescript
divider.thickness = 1;
```
